description: This file defines the Dialog class which manages dialog interactions in a browser automation context, including properties like type, message, default value, and methods to accept or dismiss dialogs.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a browser dialog (alert, prompt, confirm) with methods to accept or dismiss it, and properties to retrieve its details.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to obtain a Dialog instance from a channel object.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the page associated with the dialog.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the dialog ('alert', 'prompt', 'confirm').

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the message displayed in the dialog.

methods.name: defaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value of the prompt dialog, if any.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts the dialog, optionally providing prompt text.

ctags.name: Dialog
ctags.pattern: /^export class Dialog extends ChannelOwner<channels.DialogChannel> implements api.Dialog {$/
